  Dinner had got me craving for Biryani. So I thought why not head out and try somewhere new for Biryani in Marathahalli. So I came across Bahar cafe. [('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  Love the look and feel of the cafe. Service is good. Loved the exotica pizza, didn't like the momo platter, chaat platter was okayish.   We visited enerjuvate cafe on a Friday evening for a causal meet .
Cafe have three type of seating outdoor , indoor first floor and indoor ground floor .
Ground floor have some organic products , first floor have books to read while you can drink some good coffee.
I love the ambience .

We tried cake of the day orange cake .it was yummy . We had kashmiri kahwa to drink . Although , it was first time to drink this and I am not sure about authentic taste of it.But we liked it.
Good place for a causal hangout and chat.

Ambience 4/5
Drinks 4/5'), ('Rated 2.0', "RATED
  Lovely place but below average food.

After hogging on unhealthy food for the last week, I forced my cousin to venture into the healthy territory. And we were disappointed.

We ordered Khow Suey, Momo platter, risotto with white sauce and melon medley.

I've had Khow suey many times before, and this was honestly horrible. Very weird smell and taste.

Not a big fan of Momo's. Cool colors, but average taste, have had much better.

Risotto. Very very dry. And the toast with the risotto ?, such a small piece, I wonder what they did with the rest of the bread.

Can't complain about the juice, just that it was utterly warm which ruined the taste.

I've had amazing healthy food, and this does not cut it."), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED

  The ambiance is just so cute with little little things....

  Tasty Food is a joy forever. A tranquil ambience, picturesque view. This place is a must visit.
Situated at the heart of the city , Koramangala. Enerjuvate Studio & Cafe is one of a kind.
If you live in kormangala or nearby , this is a must visit place.
Its a Cafe + boutique with a nice range of earrings, finger rings , neck pieces and super cool kurtis.
If you are craving for some nice coolers and shakes , take your sun glasses out cause its time to visit this place.

The place offers variety of vegan dishes and amazing coolers.'), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED
  Visited this place late night for some healthy munching ...ordered choco chia pudding and DIY Thai pan and Jack in the sprout. One can easily indulge in their favourite food without feeling guilty. All the items in menu were healthy and tasty. Choco chia cup pudding was with chia seeds seeds and chocolate no sugar ...diy Thai paan was lettuce sprouts ,onion lemon chilli and mixing all was a good combo . Last but not least was Jack in the sprout ..it was tummy filling with peanuts ,sprouts.corn flakes on a lettuce leaf served with sauce.'), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED
  An amazing place to visit in Bangalore. In a world obsessed with Loud music and inebriation as the only means of enjoyment, this cafe takes us a step closer to mindful living and enjoyment in innocence. I had chanced upon their Jayanagar branch earlier and this time took my niece to Koramangala just to experience the lovely food.
The enerjuvate special pizza is scrumptious. The momos tasting platter too is a healthy mom-approved dish you should order. The Smoothies and berry drinks are amazing. I have tasted their Khao Suey and Wraps earlier.
All in all, I would keep going back. And implore you to give it a try for a calming weekend brunch or a midday meal on a workday. The ambience, the music and the vegan and handloom products on offer are amazing and I am guilty of buying these everytime.
The cherry on top: it is a Zomato Gold partner too! ??'), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED
  Just as I saw the cafe from outside my eyes were glued to their cute looking open balcony setup at the first floor perfect for two people especially if you are a couple. It looked cozy and peaceful with a pretty good view to find in Koramangala.

We started of with a summer splash smoothie and Pinapple Ginger moijito .
Summer splash was a blend of a combination of fruits which was a refreshing start and pineapple ginger moijito was really hydrating and refreshing to start with.
- 5/5

We then ordered a pizza : 4/5
Unable to recall the name but it was wheat base and first time I saw raw onion toppings on a pizza, not bad at all!

  As 1Q1 has successfully completed one year in the city, there's the Asian Street Food Festival that's going on alongside their 1st Anniversary Celebrations.

I dined her last weekend, and we tried various dishes.
We sat in the courtyard, where we could see the dishes being prepared right in front of us. There's Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian and Cambodian cuisine on the menu.

My favourite dishes were the Mi Goreng (I preferred the vegetarian one over the Chicken), Lemongrass Chicken Skewers and Chicken Bao.
Something that I tried for the first time were the Vietnamese Rice Paper Rolls (this is made very intricately) and the Mushroom Takoyaki. I think you need an acquired taste for the rice paper rolls as this isn't cooked and is made with fresh veggies and a meat of your choice.

Coming to what I loved was the Classic Cheesecake with Sour Cherry Coulis. This was just perfect.
It was a nice evening with friends where we indulged in some interesting Asian food."), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED

It was a surprise as many children use the upper platform, which is the attraction of the restaurant.

The music was too loud and at least not too my liking.

The place not has a micro brewery, a very good collection of craft beer - something that I really liked.

  Even their napkin is freaking awesome. I have been meaning to go this place since a really really long time. The day has finally arrived and all my patience has been rewarded in the form of a delicious Burmese cuisine. I have not paid any attention to the decor this time. My focus was entirely on the food. We started off with their delicious signature coolers. I really loved the spicy ginger drink. Then came the real hero....delicious and lovely lotus stem crisps...total foodgasm. For the main course, it was mohinga. It is a traditional Burmese delicacy presented with a variety of toppings. The taste was divine. I was completely satiated and satisfied. Ordered a Paneer Biriyani through Swiggy. And when I received the order, I was shocked to see the quantity of the paneer which was like 2/10th of the quantity of the biriyani.

  Their Special chicken biriyani is sumptuous and mouth watering. Go for it.

Note: Rating is based on Service and few other factors hence it is three stars.

I had been to this place twice. Taste is same across Koramangala and Indiranagar branches. But, Indiranagar branch is slightly off from the centre.

I tried Special mutton fry and Special chicken biriyani. Both are my favorites here. Special mutton fry is spicy and mouth watering. Special chicken biriyani is service with huge portion of chicken on top of basmati rice. Its huge and stomach filling.

Service was okay. Ambience was decent. Prices are a bit high compared to the similar kind of restaurants in Bangalore. But considering the quantity of food served prices are acceptable.

I would recommend this place to people who love spicy food and Andhra cuisine.

  Firangi Bake is an only delivery service at Bangalore, that has a limited menu of lasagne, rice, and steak - but serves fusion food. Cost for two is around 500, and a meal here is definitely worth it.

  Ulavacharu the restuarant which brings the finest delicacies of andhra prsdesh to our own Koramangala.

Ulavacharu itself a dish prepared from horse grame which is very famous in Andhra Pradesh.

Rustic Ambience which gives you the feel of old homes in village.

Welcoming Indian desserts were
Khaja and badusha.

Bangla Kodi a uniquely prepared dish where boneless chicken stuffed in a potato pockets.

The food was amazing especially Raju Gari kodi pulao.

And Kona Seema Kodi vepudu this was the spiciest chicken Starter I had here.

The gutti vankaya pulao this was amazing.

Tandoori fish don't miss out this guy's it's a must have here.A full size koramenu cooked with right amount of masala.

Apricot delight a very popular sweet dish of Hyderabad made with apricot and served with cream.
This was a bliss as always desserts are love."), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED

reviews_list:
[('Rated 5.0', "RATED
  Visited for today's dinner. Ordered- Vetki Paturi, Fish fry, Chicken biriyani and Chicken Moglai porota. Food was very tasty. Quantity was huge for one person. Pure Kolkata style biriyani made our mind and tummy extremely happy.
It's a big and specious restaurant with beautiful traditional bengali decor."), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED
  Went to this place on the occasion of Bhai Phota. The place is run by a Bengali person and all the staff are Bengali. The staff is well behaved , the place has enough seating capacity with a nice ambience. It is running a 30% discount on your bill since the place has opened, which makes it a budget friendly place. We had chicken biryani,luchi kosha mangsho, fish kobiraji, bhetkir paturi. All luchithe dishes were well cooked and I was delighted to have Bangali food after very long. The food is good. Should try if you are craving for Bengali food!'), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  A new bong eatery in the town. Their menu is quite small as of now, but still no regrets . Tried their doi katla thali, the taste was amazing.
The thali had rice, Alu bhaja, bhaja moong daal, doi katla and chutney. Alu bhaja and bhaja moong daal were unlimited if I'm not wrong.
The bill had 30% off as well, so peeps go there till it lasts!!??"), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED
  Loved this new Bengali place in BTM. We ordered Katla fish mean and luchi-chicken combo. There was some offer going on. The price was quite reasonable. The only concern is in dessert they have only misti doi and gulab jamun. I think they can increase the option here. Atleast rosogolla they should start keeping. Otherwise ambiance, services everything I liked about this place.'), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED
  First came across this place from the BTM Durga Puja 2018 celebration where they had given a stall there. We had been there on Ashtami day so had only veg food. The basanti pulao and aloor dum was extremely delightful. Wanted to also taste the non veg dishes so ordered the pathuri and fish cutlet to try. I must like to thank the cook for cooking such a yummy and delicious pathuri as well as the fish cutlet. Loved the taste. Looking forward to order more from here..kosha mangsho and luchi is on the wishlist...yay! Keep it up guys. :)'), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED

This Pind style Dhaba is located at the 3rd floor next to Raddisson Blu.
The ambience depicts the theme of a Bollywood style Punjabi dhaba. The place is lively and the walls are covered with Bollywood pun's.

name: Quench The Juice Lounge
reviews_list:
[('Rated 3.0', "RATED
  Incase you searching for a place with decent juice and snacks then Quench is the place to be. Located in Jayanagar this place is tough to miss due to the bright lights. The place is small but has a funky interior. The presentation of juices resemble that of keventers with the glass bottle (apparently that's a thing now). We got a butterscotch milkshake which was great, people who don't like too sweet drinks won't like this though. Their dragon fruit juice was a bit bland. The hump day juice had a nice unique taste, something definitely to try out.
Ordered a veg and paneer sandwich which was very tasty and perfectly made.
As you wait for your order in the meantime you can play couple of rounds on uno.
Over all a good experience and wouldn't mind going here again..
Cheers"), ('Rated 3.0', 'RATED
  You want to spend a fun evening with your group of friends in Jayanagar T Block, just drop by Quench-

They have a good smooth blend of juices and they are interesting to sip on a huge glass of those juices.

Their ambiance is extremely good with some very interesting murals on their walls.

Their service is pretty quick and they have jenga to play with. There could be more games and priced more reasonable.'), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED

Their french fries were perfectly cooked and served with Mayonnese, Panner and Corn Sandwiches were among the others we tried and they tasted perfect. Oreo Sundae was brilliant and my son loved it a lot. Over all a cozy place for a quick bite or to spend time talking to friends. They played good music from the mid 2010's and had friendly and polite staff. Will try their juices and smoothies in my next visit and update my feedback.")]

For starters, we ordered vegetable nachos, which were nice while they were hot. But as time went by, it became very soggy and sticky. The baby corn starter was quite nice though.   We went for a team dinner of close to 18-20 people, nothing was good in terms of taste. Chats from live counter was ok and the live counter grill was still ok, but all the sticks served on table had the same taste whether its fish or prawn or chicken or even the tangdi kebab. I am not too sure why this place is so hyped and we have been trying from long to get a reservation here so finally we went as part of the team dinner. Main course was even pathetic. its too clumsy and suffocating and if 2 people stand its get crowded and clogged.Dessert pan ice cream was good but rest were bad, cake cizes were so small that it was difficult to even hold its less than a bite size.Overall there was hardly a single item which me and anyone from my team for that matter enjoyed taste wise. His service was not bad nor was the food but his constant pestering spoiled the experience.
Here are my ratings:
Food - 4
Service - 4

  We went for a family lunch at this restaurant and was not disappointed.
Like other AB's it was also having the live counters for chats, wish grills, pastas and also paan shot ice cream.
They also now have a cotton candy counter for the children, which are fancy to them.
The staff was humble and responsive.
The service was quick but sometimes due to huge crowd it goes haywire.
The ambience was okay but the restaurant is not that spacious , due to which there is very less space between the tables and while going from one place to any counter it was not comfortable.

Coming to the food it was as expected, delicious barbecues with ample amount of deserts.
And also many dishes in the main course we're yummy specially the chicken and mutton curry.
The chats were tasty whereas the white sauce pasta was also upto the mark.

Overall a splendid lunch experience with good food and drinks."), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED

  They are still the king, the undisputed. Hands down, the best BBQ place in India. I have visited all the ABs in Bangalore and this one is comparatively a new outlet. Inspite of being new they still retain the best of ABs their service, food quality and competitive pricing.

disclaimer - most of the times we are so high on the grill we handly have space for the main course
